_comment: Map points for the four 55+ community pages, batch 2026-10-a. Researched 2026-10-07. Coordinates are WGS84 (lat, lon). Community points are the same reference points the fact ledgers use for every distance. Drive times are OSRM (router.project-osrm.org, OpenStreetMap roads) estimates without traffic; minutes over 10 are rounded to the nearest 5. The drive rows are in each ledger as '(added 2026-10-07, drive)' and are not verified yet. OpenStreetMap data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL.

landmarks.name: Kroger, 781 Main Street, North Myrtle Beach
landmarks.source: OpenStreetMap via Nominatim, relation 19221700 (shop=supermarket). Chosen as the shortest drive of 6 supermarkets of the listed chains within about 6 miles (OSRM table). Kroger's own store page refused the connection; not confirmed on the chain's site.

landmarks.name: Food Lion, 6103 N Kings Hwy, Myrtle Beach
landmarks.source: Food Lion store page (address and map point). Shortest drive of 11 supermarkets of the listed chains within about 6 miles (OSRM table).

landmarks.name: Walmart Supercenter, 151 Myrtle Ridge Drive, Conway
landmarks.source: OpenStreetMap via Nominatim, node 5315597965 (shop=supermarket). Shortest drive of 7 supermarkets of the listed chains within about 6 miles (OSRM table). Walmart's store page blocked the request; not confirmed on the chain's site. The nearest grocery-only store is Food Lion, 1904 SC 544, about 2.8 miles.

landmarks.name: Publix, 11920 Highway 707 (Prince Creek Village Center) (Prince Creek Village), Murrells Inlet
landmarks.source: OpenStreetMap via Nominatim, way 1079893614 (shop=supermarket). Shortest drive of 13 supermarkets of the listed chains within about 6 miles (OSRM table). Lowes Foods, 11903 Craven Swamp Drive, is next at 1.7 miles. Not confirmed on Publix's site (its store pages need JavaScript).
